title: Grouped by day
text: Today, Yesterday, weekdays, and dates in your timezone; holidays and non-working days named from a business calendar.

title: Status you can read
text: Every tone has its own marker icon and a status word, so nothing depends on color.

title: Three layouts
text: Vertical, alternating sides, or a horizontal milestone strip that scrolls with the keyboard.

title: Older on demand
text: Collapse older items behind "Show N older" or load them from your server with loading, error, and retry.

title: Actions per item
text: Buttons grouped and named by the item, reachable with Tab, reported as aui-action.
